verdict.rationale: Puzzle's API is URL-versioned (base path /rest/v0, per the OpenAPI document), and the vendor states that documented, released endpoints will remain stable and that it will work with users on any changes. That is only an informal stability pledge: the API is self-described as under development at v0, and the vendor states no formal deprecation policy exists. Missing for 10: a formal published deprecation policy, deprecation timelines or notice periods, a changelog, a stable (non-v0) version, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: what is currently documented here and released will remain stable for the indefinite future. We will work with you on any potential changes to assure a smooth transition.
